ui.general_settings_local_mode: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
ui.general_settings_public_mode: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
ui.general_settings_private_mode: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.
ui.general_settings_deny_description: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
ui.general_settings_censor_description: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
ui.general_settings_shortcuts_description: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.
ui.general_settings_backup_description: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
ui.general_settings_sharing_description: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
ui.general_settings_prompt_description: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
ui.general_settings_sign_out_description: Sign out of this Paperclip instance. You will be redirected to the login page.
ui.general_settings_dev_hint: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the feedbackDataSharingPreference key from the instance_settings.general JSON row for this instance, or set it back to "prompt". Unset and "prompt" both mean no default has been chosen yet.

ui.install_adapter_description: Install an adapter package to extend model support.

ui.exp_beta_skills_desc: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill.
ui.exp_cases_desc: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on.
ui.exp_chat_connectors_desc: Connect agents to Slack, GitHub, Discord, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram conversations.
ui.export_description: Export your organization data as a portable bundle.
ui.routines_description: Automated recurring task schedules and workflows.

ui.all_skills_enabled: Every library skill is enabled on this agent.

ui.installed_apps_desc: Installed apps load tools into runtime context on every run. Permitted-only apps do not add context cost.
ui.installed_apps_banner: Has access means the app is permitted. Installed means its tools are added to this agent's runtime context.
ui.no_permitted_apps_yet: No permitted apps yet. Bind an access profile to make apps available here.
ui.trust_preset_hint: Choose how broadly this agent can read and act on Paperclip work objects.
ui.inference_ledger_description: Request-scoped inference spend for the selected period.
ui.search_placeholder: 작업, 댓글, 문서, 결과물, 에이전트, 프로젝트 검색…
ui.search_description: 작업, 댓글, 기획 문서, 결과물, 에이전트, 프로젝트를 통합 검색하며 관련도 순으로 정렬됩니다.
ui.type_identifier_to_jump: PAP-123과 같이 작업 번호를 입력하면 바로 이동합니다.
ui.wrap_in_quotes_desc: 문구를 큰따옴표("")로 감싸면 일치하는 단어 조합을 찾습니다.
ui.cmd_k_desc: 언제든지 ⌘K 키를 눌러 현재 입력한 검색어로 팔레트를 엽니다.
ui.exp_decisions_desc: 사용자의 입력 및 승인을 대기 중인 업무를 표출하는 의사결정 사이드바 메뉴를 활성화합니다.
ui.exp_environments_desc: 조직 설정에서 실행 환경 관리 및 프로젝트/에이전트별 환경 할당 제어를 활성화합니다.
ui.exp_external_objects_desc: 이슈 내 외부 URL을 감지하고 상태 정보를 해석하여 표시합니다.
ui.exp_isolated_workspaces_desc: 프로젝트 설정에 실행 워크스페이스 제어를 표출하고 작업 실행 시 독립된 공간을 제공합니다.
ui.exp_file_viewer_desc: 작업 상세 화면에서 관련 워크스페이스 파일들을 탐색하고 미리보는 기능을 표시합니다.
ui.exp_paperclip_runner_desc: 신규 Codex 에이전트 생성 시 실험적 Rust Native Paperclip 러너 선택을 허용합니다.
ui.exp_simplified_english_desc: 에이전트가 승인 요청, 질의, 제안 업무 등을 더 명확하고 간결한 형식으로 사용자에게 전달하도록 지시합니다.
ui.exp_first_task_plan_desc: 사용자의 첫 요청 시 요약 계획 문서와 체크박스를 함께 생성하여 제안합니다.
ui.exp_status_cards_desc: 실험적 상태 카드 보드 및 전용 API를 활성화합니다. 비활성화하더라도 기존 데이터는 유지됩니다.
ui.exp_streamlined_ui_desc: 주요 사이드바, 받은 편지함, 에이전트 및 설정 네비게이션을 최적화된 레이아웃으로 적용합니다.
ui.exp_summaries_desc: 프로젝트 및 워크스페이스 페이지에 자동 요약 상태 카드를 표출하며 실시간 갱신을 지원합니다.
ui.exp_developer_mode_desc: 내부 디버깅 툴과 분산 추적 관찰성 링크를 활성화합니다.
ui.exp_managed_sandbox_desc: 로컬 실행 환경을 숨기고 플랫폼 관리 샌드박스 환경에서만 에이전트를 실행합니다.
ui.agent_tools_github_error_hint: Paperclip could not verify this agent's current connection. Your existing setup was not changed.
ui.agent_tools_github_dedicated_hint: Used only by {{agentName}}. This dedicated connection takes precedence over the responsible person's GitHub.
ui.agent_tools_github_responsible_hint: At run start, Paperclip uses the personal GitHub connection of the person responsible for the task.
ui.agent_tools_installed_desc: Installed apps load tools into {{agentName}}'s context on every run. Permitted-only apps do not add context cost.
ui.agent_tools_access_install_hint: Has access means the app is permitted. Installed means its tools are added to this agent's runtime context.
ui.agent_tools_no_apps: No permitted apps yet. Bind an access profile to make apps available here.
ui.agent_tools_installed_all_hint: Installed from the app page for every agent. Remove the all-agents install there.
ui.agent_tools_loaded_hint: Loaded into this agent's runtime context.
ui.agent_tools_not_installed: Permitted but not installed — tools will not appear in runs.
ui.agent_tools_effective_desc: This is exactly the tool set Paperclip will accept for {{agentName}}. Profile and policy edits are reflected within ~5 seconds. The agent's prompt can narrow this list but cannot expand it — everything else is blocked by default.
ui.agent_tools_no_tools: No tools are allowed for this agent. Bind a tool profile to grant access.
ui.agent_tools_no_profile: No active profile applies to this agent, so it has no allowed tools.
ui.agent_tools_no_policy: No enabled policy currently mutates this agent's allow list.
ui.agent_tools_all_allowed: Every known tool this agent could name is allowed.
ui.agent_tools_blocked_hint: Tools the agent could name but Paperclip would block:
ui.agent_tools_trace_hint: Capture exact provider traffic for this run (expires after 24 hours)
ui.agent_tools_trace_on_hint: Exact provider traffic will be captured for future runs and retained for up to 24 hours.
ui.exp_cases_footnote: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.
ui.exp_chat_connectors_footnote: Turning this off hides chat setup, channels, and connected-task controls. Existing chat connections keep running. GitHub and other tool connectors stay available.
ui.exp_conference_room_desc: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.
ui.exp_streamlined_ui_footnote: Turning this off restores the legacy shell and navigation. Task and page data are unchanged.
ui.discovery_no_catalog_match: No catalog skills match this filter.
ui.agent_skills_materialization_note: Enabled skills are materialized into the stable Paperclip-managed prompt bundle on the agent's next run.
ui.agent_skills_cannot_manage_custom_acp: Paperclip cannot manage skills for custom ACP commands yet.
ui.agent_skills_cannot_manage_openclaw: Paperclip cannot manage OpenClaw skills here. Visit your OpenClaw instance to manage this agent's skills.
ui.agent_skills_cannot_manage_generic: Paperclip cannot manage skills for this adapter yet. Manage them in the adapter directly.
ui.agent_skills_legacy_blocked: Paperclip Runner uses native semantic coordination and cannot attach the legacy Paperclip operational skill.
ui.agent_skills_no_detected_match: No detected skills match your search.
ui.agent_skills_stale_suffix: is enabled but missing from the organization library.
ui.agent_skills_no_library_title: No skills in the organization library
ui.agent_skills_no_library_hint: Install skills to the organization, then enable them on this agent.
